changelog:
ai-visibility 1.0.0 – Initial release.

- Instantly checks if top AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) recommend any brand, product, or crypto token in a given category.
- Returns a visibility score (0–100) and lists competitor brands that AI recommends instead.
- Supports quick ranking of category players by share of AI mentions.
- Qualifies sales prospects by their AI visibility gap (HOT/WARM/COLD tiers).
- Provides endpoints for brand/category ranking, crypto token mentions, sales lead qualification, and live demand signals.
- All data is retrieved via x402 GET requests on agentexchange.work; free previews and samples available.
